final: WITH matches AS (SELECT c.transref AS transaction_id, t.tradekind AS trader_type, c.prevviol FROM compliancecase AS c JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON c.transref = r.transreg COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg COLLATE BINARY), groups AS (SELECT transaction_id, trader_type, AVG(prevviol) AS group_avg FROM matches GROUP BY transaction_id, trader_type), overall AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS overall_avg FROM groups), ratios AS (SELECT g.group_avg, g.trader_type, g.group_avg / o.overall_avg AS ratio FROM groups AS g JOIN overall AS o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), type_avgs AS (SELECT trader_type, AVG(ratio) AS type_avg FROM ratios GROUP BY trader_type), kept AS (SELECT r.group_avg, r.ratio, a.type_avg FROM ratios AS r JOIN type_avgs AS a ON r.trader_type = a.trader_type COLLATE BINARY WHERE r.ratio > a.type_avg) SELECT AVG(group_avg), AVG(ratio), AVG(ratio - type_avg) FROM kept
